title: China may have accessed Mythos

title: Anthropic cuts off Fable 5 and Mythos 5 access following government order
text: On Friday evening, the government ordered Anthropic to block access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for all foreign nations, both inside and outside the US, due to national security concerns. title: Cybersecurity vets protest ‘dangerous’ US government ban on Anthropic’s most powerful models
text: A group made up of dozens of cybersecurity experts urged the White House to remove export control restrictions on Anthropic’s models Fable and Mythos, arguing that the order is going to limit the ability of cybersecurity defenders to secure their software and products.

title: Amazon CEO reportedly raised Anthropic model concerns before government crackdown
text: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy may have been the source of security concerns that led Anthropic to cut off worldwide access to two models on Friday.

title: OpenAI faces investigation from state attorneys general
text: It's not clear which states are involved, but they're asking about everything from OpenAI's ad policies to its handling of health data.
